description: TCS touched a day high of Rs 2,274.50 on Tuesday after winning a Rs 122.6 crore digital governance contract from Odisha.
body_lead: TCS touched a day high of Rs 2,274.50 on Tuesday after winning a Rs 122.6 crore digital governance contract from Odisha. The order is worth Rs 122.6 crore and involves building the next phase of the state’s digital governance system, known as OSWAS 3.0. This new deal extends TCS’s working relationship with the Odisha government by roughly six years. OSWAS 3.0 will bring together workflow automation, system integration, analytics, security, and artificial intelligence features onto one common digital platform.
